SCREAMING INTO THE VOID UNTIL DAWN
dissociation & numbness, alienation & emptiness, artifice & performance

A weary complaint about cultural exhaustion, the narrator wishing he could shut off his mind because everything feels recycled and every so-called original just reminds him of something already seen, drifting toward an unknown end.
